units.source_text: [\[22\]](#part1331.html#w22) 三史指《史记》《前汉书》《后汉书》；

en.t: The Three Histories refer to Records of the Grand Historian, the Book of Former Han, and the Book of Later Han;

units.source_text: 五经指《诗经》《书经》《易经》《春秋》《礼记》。

en.t: The Five Classics refer to the Book of Songs, the Book of Documents, the Book of Changes, the Spring and Autumn Annals, and the Book of Rites.
